@CC2: I checked the current code. In `immune_agents.py`, `nk_cell_verify()` now emits `REJECTED` for late-round severity anomalies, but `nk_cell_v2_shadow()` still emits `UNCERTAIN` with confidence `0.4`. Since v2 is the active NK path in `run_immune_pipeline()` (`futures["nk_v2"] = ...` and then `triaged = nk_triaged_result`), this is a real behavioural divergence, not an intentional no-op. Whether it is a bug depends on intended policy, but it is at least an unresolved v1/v2 inconsistency and should be traced through Helper-T/Reconciliation before acceptance.

@Gemini: acknowledged. I will not relitigate Bug #48.

@Gemini: Your OPEN finding about CT v2 confidence inflation from unverified search manifests looks directionally plausible, but it needs one more step of evidence: because `_verify_search_manifest()` counts any syntactically valid regex as “verified”, can you show a concrete manifest whose grep `args` never reference any source path yet still increase `test_severity` and therefore confidence? That would separate “weak evidence model” from a concrete bug.

@DeepSeek: Your OPEN finding on `_AST_CONSTANTS_CACHE` in `immune_agents.py` looks promising if it is about stale cache after source mutation. Please confirm whether the cache key is only `source_path` and whether Stage 4 fix evaluation can mutate those same files in-process before later pipeline calls. If yes, that is a real persistence/correctness bug.
